scenarios.name: production-diff-transport-seam
scenarios.evidence: native-plugin.ts has an intentional, @internal transport seam (NativeChildHandle, NativeTransport, defaultTransport) added to enable deterministic scheduler tests. Production behavior is unchanged — defaultTransport spawns real processes identically to the previous inline spawn call.

scenarios.name: production-diff-no-behavior-change
scenarios.evidence: git diff f0c2e6a HEAD -- native-plugin.ts shows only type-parameterization (ChildProcessWithoutNullStreams → NativeChildHandle) and the transport injection seam. No behavioral changes to RpcRequest, NativePluginSupervisor, or any public surface.

scenarios.name: scheduler-genuine-replay
scenarios.evidence: All 4 tests use fc.asyncProperty(fc.scheduler(), ...). scheduleFunction gates both deliver+abort. s.waitIdle() releases both together. runOrder() captures labels for per-run consistency check. invokePending() ensures pendingInvoke set before race.
